regions.explanation: From 102.82s to 105.78s (“the attack was deliberately planned many days or”), articulation rate was 5.95 syll/s against 3.55 syll/s in the reference (+67%); that is 1.7× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Faster articulation compresses the stressed syllables and the micro-pauses listeners use to segment phrases, so key words lose emphasis and comprehension drops. Fix: Slow to the reference pace here and let the pauses between clauses breathe.
